Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unestablished. Brake checks every 6,000 km. September 2024 fuel card cloning lost €4,200; second approval required above €200. Parts: 1,100 line items, contract renegotiated November 2025, supplier contact Ingrid Solheim; two quotations above €500.

Electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3. Old ticketing terminal on three routes. Training 11 days, curriculum revised April 2026. May 2026 double-published roster left two shifts uncovered; single named publisher required. Route changes need seven days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours. Winter peak capacity unmodelled.
